question: Where can I buy a replica of the Venus de Milo?
note: max_words is 75 here while shop_winged_victory_url stays at 65, because the cap has to scale with how much product data the exhibit actually has: the Venus de Milo shop section is 82 words of source text (resin replicas in three sizes, a bronze cast, two Pop Art versions, an art print, a magnet, a monograph) against 55 for the Winged Victory. The SHOP spec constrains SENTENCES (max 3), not words — this word cap is a proxy for it. At 65 the proxy was simply too tight for this exhibit: measured answers landed 59-67 across 10 runs, straddling the cap, so the case failed intermittently while producing correct, on-spec, 3-sentence answers every time. 75 keeps the guard against rambling with real headroom above the observed maximum.
